noah (ml): quick note from lucent13b bring-up: intermittent OOMs showing up under long-running chat sessions. seems correlated to int4 + deep KV chains + aggressive prefetching. reproduces after ~9-12k cumulative session tokens.
tara (infra): logs or minimal repro? is it microbatching or sustained single-session growth?
noah (ml): steady-state growth in single sessions. repro config: ```model=lucent13b quant=int4 batch=6 prefetch=aggressive max_new_tokens=1024``` stack shows KV mallocs then slab allocation failures.
ben (runtime): sounds like freelist fragmentation rather than a raw capacity bug. three fast experiments I want: 1) per-request prefetch-skip when session_token_count > 4k; 2) soft slot-reserve (reserve_ratio=0.05) so big allocations keep a small contiguous pool; 3) try hybrid fallback path (int6-ish HFQ) for very deep sessions to reduce churn.
mina (prodex): can we run a canary with those three changes plus compactor (interval=60s, qos=low)? will need messaging in console if we change default token limits.
deploy-bot: staged canary lucent13b (tag: canary/lucent13b/2026-03-23-rollup) -> nodes gpu-303,gpu-310.
noah (ml): running long-context eval (300 sessions avg 10k history). baseline before change: P95 latency=450ms, RSS peak=24.1GB, failure_rate(OOM+alloc)=1.3%.
ben (runtime): added runtime flags on canary: prefetch.skip_threshold=4000, reserve_ratio=0.05, compactor.interval=60, kv_eviction_threshold=0.72, enable_lazy_prefetch=true. also toggled experimental int6-fallback for sessions >18k tokens.
tara (infra): metrics collector added freelist_fragmentation_pct and slab_free_runaway to canary dashboards.
noah (ml): 45m snapshot: failure_rate on canary 0.08%, P95 +22ms, RSS -300MB avg. freelist_fragmentation_pct down from 18%->6%. int6-fallback not triggered yet.
mina (prodex): quality check: on our QA set EM delta int4-only vs int8 is -0.7%; with hybrid-int6 fallback above 18k it narrows to -0.15%. that's acceptable if stability improves.
ben (runtime): recommendation: adopt conservative defaults for hosted lucent13b/int4: prefetch=lazy, prefetch.skip_threshold=4000, max_new_tokens_default=512, reserve_ratio=0.05, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, compactor.qos=low with interval=60s, and hybrid-fallback:on for >18k tokens. add per-session soft throttle if eviction events >3 in 5m.
tara (infra): we'll stage default change behind a feature flag and add per-customer routing to Dedicated for any pinned max_new_tokens >1k. also add alert if freelist_fragmentation_pct >12% for >10m.
mina (prodex): updating release notes + console tooltip: "lucent13b int4 defaults optimized for long-chat stability; increase token caps on Dedicated or with reserved capacity".
noah (ml): action items: ML team to run fulleval export (convo QA + long-context SQuAD subset) and attach CSV; infra/runtime to keep canary 24h and collect fragmentation/eviction traces; prodex to author messaging.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 0 OOMs in last 120m, freelist_fragmentation_pct stable low.
ben (runtime): one more: add per-kernel isolation probe — if heavy kernels collocate (kernel_colocation_score>0.7) isolate big kernels to spare GPU to avoid transient allocation spikes.
tara (infra): added kernel_colocation probe to canary telemetry.
noah (ml): thanks all. TL;DR: root cause = prefetch + int4 + deep KV chains; mitigations (lazy/skipping prefetch, small slot reserve, compactor, hybrid fallback) look effective in canary. will post full eval and decide default switch after 24h if EM regression <=1%. :thumbsup:
